title: Assessment of Childbirth-Related Post-Traumatic Stress Disorder
official: Assessment of Childbirth-Related Post-Traumatic Stress Disorder: A Single-Center Prospective Study
summary: The main objective of this study is to estimate the prevalence of childbirth-related post-traumatic stress disorder (PTSD) among mothers treated at the maternity ward of Emile Muller Hospital (Mulhouse, Haut-Rhin, France).

interventions.name: City Birth Trauma Scale and Questionnaire on the assessment of healthcare utilization

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:

* Women aged 18 or older
* Having given birth in the maternity ward at Emile Muller Hospital (Mulhouse, Haut-Rhin, France)
* Fluent in French
* Having provided written consent to participate in the study
* Being covered by a social security program

Exclusion Criteria:

* Women who gave birth anonymously
* Women who gave birth to a stillborn child or a fetus that died in utero
* Women under legal protection (guardianship, conservatorship, judicial protection).
